name: drawtell
description: draw & tell — turn problems into stroke-by-stroke chalkboard explanations, from your terminal.

scripts.build:lib: rm -rf dist/cli dist/player dist/schema dist/glyphs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/player/chalk-player.css dist/player/ && node scripts/fix-dts.mjs
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types tests/letters.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tests/typecheck.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tests/scene-v2.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tests/scene-files.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tests/workspace.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tests/note.test.ts
scripts.sync-fonts: rm -rf public/fonts && mkdir -p public && cp -R node_modules/@excalidraw/excalidraw/dist/prod/fonts public/fonts
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build:lib && node --input-type=module -e "const { main } = await import('./dist/cli/main.js'); await main(['--version']);"

author: tarslab
